newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up 14 cents to 14.29 cents/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up 14 cents to 14.29 cents/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rose 14 cents to 14.29 ringgit ($5.48) a kg after tracking a strong close on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"It was basically because of the LME," said a trader. "Good buying support came in from the Japanese, Europeans and locals."
Traders said the closing price was at a discount of $20 a tonne against London, compared to $15 on Friday.
At the opening, there were bids for 217 tonnes against offers for 119.
Final turnover was 203 tonnes, against 197 on Friday.
Traders said the next resistance for the market was at 14.50 ringgit.
